title: Evaluation report
description: Explainable, replayable evaluation report produced by B2 (RQ-B-2-80). A score is not a scalar here: it is a set of per-rule and per-case conclusions, each carrying evidence, so a third party can re-check it. The report is bound to five digests; identical digests must reproduce an identical score and identical per-item evidence (ADR-0005).

state.description: Terminal state. 'rejected' means the submission broke a rule or a security policy; 'failed' means the system could not complete the evaluation. Neither may be presented as a low score.

overall.description: Overall assessment: score, full marks, pass flag and a conclusion summary.

summary.description: Deterministic, rule-derived conclusion text. Not model-generated: scoring never depends on an LLM (ADR-0005).

static_findings.description: Static legality findings (RQ-B-2-40). A high-severity finding blocks dynamic execution and makes the outcome 'rejected'; in that case the report must not claim the code ran successfully.

blocking.description: Whether this finding blocked dynamic execution.

security_conclusion.description: Three-state security conclusion. 'not_checked' is distinct from 'not_found': an unperformed check must never be reported as a clean result.

case_evidence.description: Per-case evidence (RQ-B-2-50). Reports digests and truncated excerpts rather than whole outputs, and never leaks a hidden case's expected output to the student view.

actual_output_excerpt.description: Truncated per the output limit. Omitted entirely for hidden cases in the student view.

expected_output_excerpt.description: PROTECTED. Omitted for hidden cases; only visible cases may expose it.

resource.description: Measured resource use for this case (CHG-0012). Null when the host could not measure it -- e.g. no cgroup v2 -- which is honest ('not measured') rather than zero, because a zero reads as 'used nothing'. Before this field the resource ledger was a set of configured limits nobody ever compared against reality.

artifacts.description: What this case did to the workspace files (CHG-0012). Closes a gap the integration audit found: per-case file digests were computed, then used only to pick an excerpt and discarded, so 'the produced file matched' was unauditable and `RQ-B-0-30` acceptance 2 had no implementation anywhere.

explanation.description: A deterministic, rule-derived explanation of this case's outcome (CHG-0012). It is NOT model output: fixed rules over the evidence in this same object, so it is reproducible and may be treated as part of the report. Model-generated teaching commentary lives in a separate track (ADR-0009, RQ-T-20) and must never appear here -- if it did, the report would stop being replayable.

binding.description: The five digests that make replay meaningful. When all five match a previous run, the score and per-item evidence must match too; recording them separately also makes it possible to say exactly which input changed when a result legitimately differs.

question_version_binding.description: Content digest of the question version, so a later edit to the question cannot silently change the meaning of a past score.

total_check.description: Arithmetic self-check. The sum of item awards must equal the overall score; a mismatch is a defect that must fail a test, not be rounded away.

result_digest.description: Digest over the report content, used as the replay equality check.

case_resource.description: Peak resource use observed for one case. Every field is nullable because a sandbox may be able to enforce a limit without being able to report the peak; 'enforced but unmeasured' and 'measured as small' are different facts.

limit_hit.description: Which enforced limit ended the case, if any. Null means no limit was hit.

case_artifacts.description: File-level outcome of one case. Digests are recorded so the comparison is checkable after the fact; the change lists are recorded so `RQ-B-0-30` acceptance 2 ('which files the submission modified, with content digests') is answerable at all.

expected_sha256.description: PROTECTED. Digest of the expected produced file. Omitted from the student view: a digest is not content, but it is a checkable oracle for a guessed file, and only visible cases may expose it.

file_change_list.description: Workspace-relative paths, sorted, so the list is comparable between runs. Bounded because a runaway case must not produce an unbounded report.
